thread:
marcus: quick note from canary: several rollouts showed inconsistent degrade labels. console shows fallback happened but no breakdown.
mohit: traced it the policy pipeline calls quota + cost-estimator + compat. we collapse reasons downstream which hides the root cause.
ashley: product needs discrete reasons. otherwise folks chase the wrong fix.
paula: can we add a concise reason chain to the audit event? e.g. 'quota:slow->estimator:ok->final:fallback'
tim: yes, but avoid blocking the hot path. carry a tiny decision_token in the request and assemble full trace async.
mohit: agreed. suggest sampling full traces to replay queue (default 0.1%) and store compact reason chains for all requests.
ops-bot: feature-flag rollout.decision_trace_token created. alert decision.trace_backlog if queue latency > 60s.
ashley: console: show a Decision Breakdown column on rollouts with counts for quota/cost/compat. clicking a count opens sampled traces.
marcus: add signal for false-fallback estimation: compare sampled replays to retroactive results when services respond quickly.
paula: security: redact prompts by default. store only metadata + anonymized examples unless customer opts in.
mohit: implementation items: add header X-Decision-Token, emit decision_event with reason_chain and latency_ms, enqueue full trace when sampled.
ashley: UX item: toggle to store last N traces per-rollout, default 100, retention 7d. also small badge if shortcircuit_rate > 0.5%.
ops-bot: deploy plan: canary 2% for 3h, rollback window 30m, monitor decision.shortcircuit_rate and trace_queue_depth.
marcus: will draft RFC with examples and a privacy checklist. closing thread when RFC lands.
